title: Landing.ai Extract
description: Extracts structured fields from parsed Markdown using Landing.ai ADE and a
JSON Schema you upload. Runs downstream of Landing.ai Parse, consuming the
Markdown it produces and emitting the extracted key-value data.

landing_ai_extract.schema_file.title: Extraction Schema (JSON Schema file)
landing_ai_extract.schema_file.description: Upload a .json file describing the fields to extract. Supports the ADE x-alternativeNames and format keywords.

landing_ai_extract.strict.title: Strict
landing_ai_extract.strict.description: Fail the extraction when the document does not match the schema, instead of returning partial results.

landing_ai_extract.region.title: Region
landing_ai_extract.region.description: Which Landing.ai deployment to call. Use EU for the eu-west-1 data-residency endpoint.
